description: Plan and inspect geometric candidates before explicitly selecting pairs. Example paths, candidate IDs and SHA values must be replaced with the actual pinned result.
review: Inspect the marked PNG, distances, ambiguity and source pose. Geometric confidence does not establish anatomical correctness or human approval.
physicsOptIn: Set compatibility.physics=sampled_capture only when finite deterministic capture is intended. Repair FPS must be 30/60 and physicsFps at least twice repair FPS. Defaults reject physics and linked dependencies.
independentAudit: Use spine_audit_mesh_seams with candidate.details.verification.resolvedTargets, the returned output skin, new animation and selected seam definitions. Source-relative mode additionally requires referenceAnimation, referenceSkin and original referenceTargets when private placeholders were created.
publication: Failed candidates cannot publish. Inspect comparisons; explicitly select the exact candidate SHA. Use suggestedPublishQuality to select the derived clip/output skin. Independently audit the published native file. New skins are scoped to new repaired clips; original skins/clips remain unchanged.
